summary: Implemented frontend UI and React Query hooks for bank transfer setup and customer display, plus header entry point for admins. Backend changes are truncated; required backend persistence/admin-only enforcement for bank details is not evidenced. Some extra bank detail fields (IBAN/BIC) were added beyond the requested schema, and the frontend query calls an oddly named backend method (`getBankRequirements`) which may not match the intended API.

missing_requirements.requirement: Bank transfer details are persisted in canister state (survive canister upgrades).
missing_requirements.reason: The backend diff snippet does not show any stable variables, preupgrade/postupgrade hooks, or other upgrade-safe persistence for the new bank transfer details.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes an admin-only method to set/update bank transfer details; unauthorized (non-admin) callers cannot set/update bank transfer details (must trap with a clear error).
missing_requirements.reason: The backend diff snippet does not show the new bank-details setter method or its admin check/trap behavior.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes a public query method to fetch the currently configured bank transfer details (or null/none if not configured).
missing_requirements.reason: The backend diff snippet does not show any bank-details query method; additionally, the frontend hook calls `actor.getBankRequirements()` which is not evidenced in the backend snippet.

hallucinated_features.description: Extended bank transfer details schema/UI to include IBAN and BIC fields.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asked for bank name, account name, account number, and optional note; IBAN/BIC were not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Frontend fetch hook calls `actor.getBankRequirements()` (unexpected API name).
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest specifies fetching bank transfer details but does not mention a `getBankRequirements` method; this may be an unrequested API shape and could indicate a mismatch with the intended backend method.
